name: Rhone Ma Holdings Berhad
summary: Rhone Ma Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, trading, marketing, and distribution of biotechnology and animal health products primarily in Malaysia. The company provides diagnostic laboratory analysis and consultation services to veterinary, agriculture, and food industries; tests and diagnostics services for human healthcare; and veterinary advisory services. It also conducts research and development in biotechnology; distributes human healthcare and related products; wholesales and distributes pharmaceutical and veterinary products, including animal feeds; undertakes research and development activities related to animal health, food safety, and agriculture; and distributes and supplies food ingredients. In addition, the company involved in the raising, breeding, and production of semi-domesticated animals; provision of training services; and dairy farming business. Further, it engages in buying, selling, renting or leasing any land or building for business purpose. Rhone Ma Holdings Berhad was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
